info.title: semrel registry API
info.description:
The semrel plugin registry. The public catalogue is readable without authentication; publishing and review require a GitHub session.

Browsers authenticate with an HttpOnly `semrel_session` cookie set by the OAuth callback. API clients (the semrel CLI, CI jobs) send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

tags.name: publishing
tags.description: Managing your own plugins and versions.

200.description: Links to the catalogue, health check and docs.

get.description: The index the semrel CLI consumes. Carries a strong ETag; send If-None-Match to get a 304 instead of the whole document.

ETag.description: Strong validator over the response body.

304.description: The client's cached copy is current.

get.description: Anonymous callers see active plugins. An authenticated non-admin additionally sees their own plugins in every state; an admin may filter by status.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Full-text and partial-identifier search. Results are ranked by relevance unless an explicit sort is given.

parameters.name: compatibleWith
parameters.description: A concrete semrel core version. Returns only plugins whose latest installable release declares a compatibility range admitting it. Plugins that declare no range are included: the metadata is optional and most of the catalogue predates it.

post.description: Non-admin callers have the author forced to their own GitHub login.

put.description: Non-admins may only update plugins they author, and may not reassign the author.

delete.description: Requires a typed confirmation matching the plugin reference.

200.description: Versions, newest first. Yanked versions are included and flagged.

post.description: downloadUrl must be an HTTPS URL on an allowed artifact host, and every checksum a hex SHA-256 digest.

307.description: Redirect to the artifact on an allowed host.

post.description: For clients that fetch the artifact directly. Counted once per client per version per hour.

delete.description: Breaks installs that pin this version. Prefer yanking.

put.description: Retracts the release without breaking installs that pin it: it stays resolvable but is never chosen as latest or as an update target. The reason is shown to consumers.

get.summary: List versions of a namespaced plugin

post.summary: Submit a community plugin for review
post.description: Creates the plugin with status=pending. The author is forced to the submitter's GitHub login.

post.summary: Check a repository against the plugin standards
post.description: Unauthenticated but throttled: each call fans out into several GitHub API requests.

post.summary: Release notification from a plugin repository
post.description: Authenticated with an HMAC over the raw request body: `X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=<hex>`, keyed with WEBHOOK_SECRET. The legacy `X-Webhook-Secret` header is still accepted but deprecated.

200.description: The release was imported or already known.

404.description: The repository is not a registered plugin.

delete.description: Requires an interactive GitHub sign-in within the last five minutes. Responds 401 with code REAUTH_REQUIRED when the session is older.

post.description: Revokes the session server-side and clears the cookie, so the token cannot be replayed until it expires.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: A same-site path to return to. Absolute URLs are rejected.

get.description: Sets the HttpOnly session cookie and redirects to the admin app. The token never appears in the URL.

307.description: Redirect to the frontend, with Set-Cookie.

get.description: For GitHub Apps configured without the /github path segment.

200.description: Whether GitHub OAuth is configured, and where to start it.
Totals, per-category counts and top plugins.

put.description: The reason is required and shown to the author.

get.description: Relayed from GitHub and cached for 30 minutes. The body is author-supplied markdown and must be sanitised before rendering.

404.description: No GitHub repository on record, or no README.

sessionCookie.name: semrel_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax session cookie set by the OAuth callback. Browser clients use this; mutating requests are additionally checked against the Origin header.

bearerAuth.description: For non-browser clients. The static ADMIN_TOKEN is accepted outside production only.

webhookSignature.name: X-Hub-Signature-256
webhookSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body, keyed with WEBHOOK_SECRET, formatted as sha256=<hex>.

PluginRef.name: id
PluginRef.description: Numeric id, plugin name, or alias.

Namespace.name: namespace
Namespace.description: Namespace without the leading @, which is part of the path.

Version.name: version
Version.description: The release version string, without a leading v.

ValidationError.description: The request was rejected by validation.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required, or the session has expired.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but not permitted. Publishers may only touch their own plugins.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining describe the budget.

rejectionReason.description: Why a submission was rejected. Shown to the author.

latestSemrelCore.description: The semrel core compatibility range of latestVersion.

PluginPatch.description: Only the supplied fields are changed.

checksums.description: Hex SHA-256 digests keyed by GOOS_GOARCH.

downloadUrl.description: HTTPS, on an allowed artifact host.

reason.description: Shown to everyone who has this version pinned.

reauthToken.description: Bearer-authenticated API clients only; browsers re-authenticate with GitHub instead.

Catalogue.description: The registry index. Its authoritative schema is schemas/plugin-metadata.json.

markdown.description: Untrusted markdown. Sanitise before rendering as HTML.

source.description: Canonical URL of the README on GitHub.

notifyEmail.description: Optional, opt-in address for the review outcome. Stored apart from the plugin record, never returned by any endpoint, and erased when the account is deleted.
